about: What scripts/build.mjs must never put in dist/ (Dom 2026-10-26, 106 only: "no risk of going back to the old 65 rig"; docs/PLAN.md section 10). `notShipped`: the 65-joint body GLBs, their 65-rigged kits and the 65-keyed baked clip JSONs. They stay in src/assets for the tests, Gate 0 tooling and the bakes (scripts/foe-body, scripts/hero-body, scripts/hero-clips), but no production loader names them. The build fails if the bundle references one (a new URL(...) or import(...) of it) or if one (or its content-hashed copy) lands in dist/; test/rig-bones.test.mjs checks the source and, after a build, dist/.
